newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Alliance seeks talks with Labour on coalition.
newsitem.headline: NZ Alliance seeks talks with Labour on coalition.

text.p: New Zealand's left-wing Alliance called on Tuesday for urgent talks with the Labour Party on prospects for a coalition after the October 12 general election, Radio New Zealand said.
Radio NZ quoted Alliance leader Jim Anderton as saying there was a demand from the community for Labour and the Alliance to work together.
He said it was time for serious discussions in a "constructive and conciliatory" way.
Labour and the Alliance are jointly drawing just over 30 percent support in recent opinion polls.

Attempts at a rapprochement between the two parties have previously foundered over Anderton's insistence on a pre-election agreement, with Labour saying deal-making must wait until after the election.
